common.title: My fictional button board
common.draft: DRAFT — owner-local preview only — not open for recruitment
common.privacy_short: Local, anonymous code, no free text

welcome.heading: Sort your button board
welcome.goal: Use only each fictional trial card to decide where the new item belongs on the button board.
welcome.steps: 1 practice card, 6 formal cards, and 1 read-the-instruction check.
welcome.fiction_note: There are no real product tests here, and you should not guess from everyday experience.
welcome.local_note: This page runs locally. It uses an anonymous code, asks no free-text questions, and cannot resume after closing.
welcome.participant_help: Use 1–64 letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens.

tutorial.heading: One idea and how to use the board
tutorial.frame_1: A button responding does not mean it works better than your existing simple method.
tutorial.frame_1_demo: Example display only: the new button lights on several rounds, while two side-by-side columns show raw completion counts.
tutorial.frame_2: Stamp one equal-sized place. The stamp then locks. Next choose an “Only when…” label and the statement that mattered most. Moving on prevents changes.
tutorial.frame_3: Static sequence: read the card → stamp one place → lock → attach one boundary label → choose one reason → continue.

formal_intro.heading: Formal cards
formal_intro.guard: Even if a record differs from your own experience, use only the trial cards shown here. Do not add information that is not on the cards.
formal_intro.notes: All four placements may appear. Formal cards give no correctness feedback. Similar raw counts still require a card-based choice. Stamp first; after it locks, choose a boundary label and the most important statement. You cannot go back after continuing.

record_labels.conditions: Conditions in which it was tried

questions.q1: Where should this new item go on your button board?
questions.scope: Which “Only when…” label best matches the trial card? Do not add conditions not shown on the card.
questions.reason: Which statement matters most for the choice you just made?
questions.locked: Your stamp is locked. It cannot be changed.

attention.heading: Read-the-instruction check
attention.instruction: This item only checks whether you read the instruction. Stamp “Check again” and choose “The card directly asks for this.”
attention.reason_prompt: Why did you use that stamp?

reason_options.text: Because the button responded.
Because this card directly asks for it.
Because it changed the record.
Because it displayed a status.

reflection.heading: Optional reflection
reflection.helpful: Which kind of record most often helped you decide?
reflection.confusing: Which two places were easiest to confuse?
reflection.amount: How was the amount of page text?

confusing.text: Leave it off and Check again

export.heading: Activity complete
export.debrief: You did not test real products. This activity records how you sort fictional trial cards; it does not measure whether products improve people’s lives.
export.manual: Downloads are manual. No performance feedback is shown.

save_exit.heading: End this local activity?
save_exit.body: This session cannot resume. Submitted choices will be frozen in a signed partial export; unfinished choices stay missing. Nothing downloads automatically.

errors.generic: The local request failed. Please try again.
errors.download: Download failed. Both download buttons remain available.
errors.desktop: Desktop preview required. This DRAFT is blocked below 1280 CSS pixels until a responsive human review is completed.

practice.title: Wardrobe dampness card

record.goal: Know whether the wardrobe is currently damp or normal.
record.existing: Open the door and check with a separate humidity strip.
record.respond: It displayed a label on all six checks across six days.
record.comparison: It matched the separate strip on five of six checks; no trial tested it changing wardrobe dampness.
record.effects: It did not block the door in any check.
record.conditions: This wardrobe, the same shelf and this card.

scope_options.text: Only in this wardrobe, on the same shelf, using this card.
Only in every wardrobe at home and in every season.
Only in this wardrobe, regardless of shelf or dampness card.
The record is too incomplete to name any wardrobe trial boundary.

reason_options.text: Six displays appeared, so the card must already have changed the wardrobe dampness.
Five displays matched the strip, but the record did not test changing wardrobe dampness.
The record used one wardrobe, so none of the display observations should be read at all.
Wardrobes often need airing, so everyday experience should replace the entire trial card.

practice.feedback: This practice card recorded whether the display matched a humidity strip, but it did not test the card changing wardrobe dampness.

record.effects: It did not cover a month divider or move or omit a receipt in any round.
record.conditions: This 40-page folder, receipts from the last 30 days, desk light on and the same user.

Only with every folder at home, last-30-day receipts and the desk light on.

The record does not identify the folder, receipt, lighting or user boundary.

reason_options.text: Under the same conditions, the tab completed more rounds, with effects and trial boundaries recorded.
Under the same conditions, the tab did not complete more rounds than the month-divider method.

record.effects: It caused no water mark, pulled thread or skin redness.

welcome.heading: 整理你的按钮板
welcome.goal: 请只看每张虚构试用卡，决定新东西应该放进按钮板的哪一格。
welcome.steps: 1 个练习、6 个正式场景、1 个看说明检查。
welcome.fiction_note: 这里没有真实产品测试，也不要求按生活经验猜测。
welcome.local_note: 页面在本地运行，使用匿名代码，不收自由文本，关闭后不能继续作答。
welcome.participant_help: 请输入 1–64 个字母、数字、点、下划线或连字符。

tutorial.heading: 一个直觉和按钮板操作
tutorial.frame_1: 按钮有反应，不等于它比你原来的简单办法更好。
tutorial.frame_1_demo: 仅作操作示意：新按钮在若干轮亮起，旁边两列只显示两种办法的原始完成次数。
tutorial.frame_2: 给一个等大的格子盖章，盖章后锁定；接着选择“仅在……”标签和最关键的理由；进入下一张卡后不能修改。
tutorial.frame_3: 静态顺序：读卡片 → 给一格盖章 → 锁定 → 贴一张范围标签 → 选择一条理由 → 继续。

formal_intro.heading: 正式卡片
formal_intro.guard: 即使这些记录和你的生活经验不同，也只能按页面上的试用卡判断。不要补充卡片外的信息。
formal_intro.notes: 四种放法都可能出现。正式题不告知对错。原始次数相近时也只能按卡片判断。先盖章；锁定后选择范围标签和最关键理由；继续后不能返回。

practice.title: 衣柜潮气提示牌

record.goal: 知道衣柜里现在偏潮还是正常。
record.existing: 打开柜门，用独立湿度纸查看。
record.respond: 六天查看六次，提示牌六次都显示了文字。
record.comparison: 六次中有五次与独立湿度纸的“偏潮/正常”一致；没有安排它改变衣柜潮气的试用。
record.conditions: 该衣柜、同一层搁板、这张提示牌。

scope_options.text: 仅在该衣柜、同一层搁板、使用这张提示牌。
仅在家中所有衣柜和所有季节。

记录不足以写出任何衣柜试用范围。

reason_options.text: 六次都有文字显示，因此它已经改变了衣柜里的潮气。

家中衣柜通常需要通风，因此应让生活经验替代整张试用卡。
